notes.title: Thank You for 1 Million Sales & Future Update Plans
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 



Double Cross Studio & 2P Games here!



Thank you so much for your support! We did it together - Sultan's Game just hit 1 million copies sold on Steam! Your feedback and suggestions have been incredible. They've really helped us keep making the game better and better.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145473/7024d985b281276e2d2639fb00322b6ba223e5dc.png"]

To celebrate our sales and a series of exhibitions and online events in July, we will continue a 15% discount until July 24. 



Over the next six months, we'll keep doing regular fixes and improvements while bringing you these exciting updates:


Crowdfunded Character Update
During crowdfunding, we created a brand new character for Sultan's Game based on eighteen community-voted questions. Right now we're putting the finishing touches on their dialogue and getting the multi-language localization ready. You'll get to meet them this August!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145473/0aa8ace02d3c4a1b96272bea10eefcfd1619d99d.jpg"]
 Gallery Feature Update
We're expanding the History Gallery way beyond just temporary ending records. We're adding tons of collectible content - card galleries, ending collections, you name it.


 MOD Support
We're opening up parts of the game that were previously locked down, giving MOD creators way more freedom to customize content however they want. Plus, we're tackling compatibility issues to make the modding experience smoother for everyone.


Character Story Updates
We see how much you love learning about character backstories! A lot of characters are missing their full personal storylines right now, and we're going to fix that. The Court Physician, vagrant leader Raed, those starting companions from the Fate Shop - they're all getting their stories told. Keep an eye out!

 New Game Endings

If you've been paying attention to the Nursery's fifteen ideology achievements, you've probably noticed two are still missing... We're working on those endings and their Epilogues to complete the full story.

 Epilogue Expansions

Some endings also need their Epilogues fleshed out. We'll be gradually adding this content so you can see how different choices lead to different character fates.



 We'll keep polishing the game and rolling out these updates while fixing any issues that come up. We're always listening to your feedback! If you run into any problems, just hit us up through our feedback form and we'll jump on it.



 Thanks again for helping us reach this amazing milestone. We're committed to making every update worth your excitement. Enjoy the game!

 - Double Cross Studio & 2P Games

notes.title: Update V-1.0.11241
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Hello everyone! Thank you for your ongoing feedback and suggestions, and we’re so excited to roll out our latest update to address the resolution bug for Mac devices and to fix several level issues reported by community. The good news is that 4K resolution configuration is now properly supported for 4K screen users!

We’re still improving compatibility for controller and Steam Deck. To address the frequently reported card management issues, we’ll soon introduce an auto-filtering category feature to help players sort cards more efficiently.

For special follow-up events in the game, we’re considering adding visual indicators to help players make decisions. More optimizations are under ongoing evaluation and discussion, and adjustments will be made based on your feedback.

All fixes and improvements will be rolled out in the coming days. If you encounter any issues, please submit feedback via our [Issue Report Form] , and we will follow up promptly and fix the relevant issues.

Update Details:

 Fixed the issue causing Language/Resolution couldn't be set on MAC devices.
 Fixed the issue where Fate's Ledger scrolled to the top.
 Fixed the issue preventing Sultan's Harem achievement to be completed in 1001 Nights.
 Water of Life was added to Mahir's Long-Term Research results without using Aether.
 Optimized events positioning in the Temple District to reduce overlap.
 Increased the waiting time for the Lunchbox Business event.
 Fixed the issue where the Golden Jinn had a chance to trigger the Ansuya storyline incorrectly.
 Fixed the issue preventing some of Nayla’s branches to be triggered during the Matchmaker event.
 Fixed the issue occurred after stealing the Holy Blood multiple times.
 Fixed the issue where gold coins could be placed in the Managing the Estate.
 Fixed the issue where Project Investment couldn't eliminate the Extravagance card.


Once again, we sincerely appreciate our players for continued support and patience. We are committed to bringing more exciting game content to live up to your expectations. 

- Double Cross & 2PGames

notes.title: Steam Next Fest & Demo Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145473/af156a83ec1ccad91e420d4d816569626d76738c.jpg
Dear Subjects!

We are excited to inform you all that the demo of Sultan’s Game will be updated to honour the glorious Steam Next Fest. From October 14th you can play the new version—bloodier than ever!.

Thank you infinitely to all who have been playing the game already. We’re amazed by those of you who spent +80h on the game, lol. The good news is that you will keep your progress in the Steam Next Fest demo. So don’t cry over spilled Fate points, because they won’t be spilled. To those of you who haven’t already tried the game. Welcome to the court! And fear not, because the demo will remain available even after the festival ends so you can play over, and over, and over again.
You can thank your merciful Sultan for that!

What you need to know about this new demo:

 We’ve implemented a roguelike progression to make it more interesting
 Your previous game save is compatible with this version. You can continue your journey from where you left off.
 We’ve fixed bugs based on your reports (thanks!) and optimized the game
 New feature – Fate Shop.

The Fate Shop will make it easier for you to face the game’s challenges and exploring hidden secrets. Every time you resolve a Sultan’s card or complete certain tasks, you’ll earn a Fate Point, which can be redeemed to upgrade character’s abilities, hire allies and unlock other enhancements.

The Fate Shop will include more content on the final version of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145473/08b9854883f7933e3418e2b275057fe570361f52.jpg

Please note that because the game is still in development, the demo version may contain some events that are difficult to complete, stories that are too simple in text, and unfinished translations.

You can report bugs or discuss with other players via our Discord (on Strategy-Games-Group): 2pgames.net/discord 

You’re all dismissed!

Doublecross Team
